description: Converting a tuple to a set of lists of any doesn't unify the element types of the lists
notes: The spec converts a tuple to a set as if it first converted the tuple to a list of the same element type and then that list to the set (spec.md#collection-and-structural-type-conversions). Converting this tuple to a list of lists of any gives lists of strings, as native/types/convert-object-to-map-of-lists-of-any-unifies-lists does for a map, so the set would hold ["1"] and ["x"]. go-cty's conversionTupleToSet (cty/convert/conversion_collection.go) converts each element on its own, to a list of numbers and a list of strings, and unlike conversionTupleToList it doesn't unify the converted elements, so the conversion fails.
reference_error: element types must all match for conversion to set
